who_can_apply: You can surrender your NSW driver or rider licence and return it to a Service NSW Centre.
You can hand in a driver or rider licence for a licence holder who has died.
what_you_need: Your driver or rider licence (if available)
The completed PDF form 'Change of Records – Road and Maritime Products'
If returning a licence for someone else, the representative needs proof of their identity and one of the following: proof of the licence holder's identity or confirmation of death.
If handing in the licence for specific reasons, you will also need the relevant document.

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the PDF form – Change of Records – Road and Maritime Products.
Take the completed form, documents and the NSW Driver Licence to a service centre.

faqs.q: Can I use a NSW Photo Card as proof of identity?
faqs.a: Yes, you can use a NSW Photo Card to prove your identity in most places a driver licence is recognised.

faqs.q: Do I have to pay to get a NSW Photo Card if I cancel my driver licence?
faqs.a: No, you do not have to pay to get a NSW Photo Card when you cancel a NSW Driver Licence.

faqs.q: What do I need to hand in a licence for someone who has died?
faqs.a: To hand in a licence for someone who has died, you will need confirmation of death, such as a death certificate.
